question.text: At a certain temperature, the degrees of freedom per molecule for gas is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>8</mn></math>. The gas performs <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>150</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">J</mi></math> of work when it expands under constant pressure. The amount of heat absorbed by the gas will be _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">J</mi></math>.

solution.text:
For constant pressure process,

Work done is given by W=nRΔT=150 J, here, R is gas constant.

Now, for above process, f=8.

So, specific heat at constant pressure is CP=1+f2R.

Amount of heat adsorbed by the gas is 

Q=nCPRΔT=f2+1nRΔT=82+1150=750 J
